errors.error_description: Introduced an unintended latch by omitting the final else branch in an always_comb block and conditionally assigning load_en_d only on some paths.
Created a port width mismatch by connecting an 8-bit slice count[7:0] to a 4-bit submodule input port b during instantiation.
Drove a top-level input port ext_enable from within the module using a continuous assign statement.
Implemented a deeply nested chain of if-else conditions to compute dynamic_step4, creating a long combinational path that is highly suboptimal for synthesis.
